method: Point elevation at the destination's stored coordinate. Only coordinates with >=3 decimals that are not whole-arc-minute rounded were queried. DEM terrain height at the point: approximate, not a surveyed village/summit height (90 m DEM under-reads sharp summits).
scope: Approved destinations in Himalayan/high districts (Solukhumbu, Rasuwa, Mustang, Taplejung, Myagdi, Dolpa, Dolakha, Manang, Sindhupalchok, Humla, Gorkha, Sankhuwasabha, Jumla, Mugu, Bajhang, Kalikot, Bajura, Rukum East, Darchula, Jajarkot) plus Kaski/Lamjung north of 28.30N. Others: run `manage.py backfill_elevations --fetch` with internet access.
